question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Dingy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Dreary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dingy"** means something that is gloomy, dismal, or lacking brightness and cleanliness. (मैला, अंधेरा)

 
 
• **Example: **The old, dingy curtains made the room look even more depressing.
 
 
 
• **"Dreary"** refers to something that is dull, bleak, and lifeless; depressing in character or appearance. (उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example: **The dreary weather made everyone feel sluggish and unmotivated.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'dingy' **is **'dreary'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Dreary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pure **(शुद्ध): Free from any contamination or impurities.

 
 
• **Example:** The water from the mountain spring is so pure and refreshing.
 
 
 
• **Sterile **(निष्फल): Free from bacteria or other living microorganisms; totally clean.
 
 
• **Example: **Surgeons work in a sterile environment to prevent infections.
 
 
 
• **Bright** (चमकदार): Giving out or reflecting a lot of light; shining.
 
 
• **Example:** The bright sunlight filled the room with warmth and cheerfulness.
